signal: Daxko acquired Exercise.com to expand its boutique fitness market footprint

email.body1:
Callie, saw Daxko picked up Exercise.com to push deeper into the boutique fitness market.

Stepping into a new segment usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover, and that is where revenue marketing leaks pipeline before reps ever ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Daxko off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

email.body2:
Callie, quick follow-up for Daxko.

When a new market opens up, the number of meetings needed to hit the number jumps faster than the team can. Most revenue orgs don't actually know that gap until the quarter is already slipping, and recovering it late is brutal.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Daxko needs to cover the boutique segment this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Callie, last bit of proof for Daxko.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Daxko's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Callie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Integrating a new acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-segment motion like Daxko's? I'll tailor it to you either way.
